oracle.statement_vi: Do bang so hang trong DB that ma jobs/ingest ghi, bang so lan doc nguon, va bang ma tra ve — khong bang log. (a) Mot chu ky day du: dang ky KHONG cap lease (assignment_lease rong, LM-01); sau chu ky COUNT(post)=20, MAX(checkpoint.acked_through_ingest_sequence)=20, COUNT(ingest_receipt)>=1, run.status='running', lease state='released', run.current_lease_epoch=2. (b) Chu ky challenge: COUNT(post)=20 va 7 bai da tai KHONG co hang nao; checkpoint khong doi; SERVER dat run.status='needs_user' va run.stop_reason='captcha' tu 'challenge_required' cua collector (T-RUN-09). (c) I10: run_forever(max_cycles=5) chi chay 1 chu ky, thoat SESSION_NEEDS_OWNER, so lan doc nguon dung o 3, khong claim lai. (d) Khong claim khi phien khong 'ok': 0 chu ky, assignment_lease khong bao gio duoc ghi. (e) T-RUN-02: limit_reached, error_code=None, coverage note khac rong, lease duoc tra, run van 'running'. (f) AMD-B05: sau run.resume, doan hai doc lai 7 bai cu + 3 bai moi => 20 -> 30 hang, khong phai 40. (g) Sau khi tra lease, mot report_stop muon nhan STALE_LEASE va khong doi gi. (h) I13: no_work la 200, loop ngu dung retry_after_ms cua server, 0 lan doc nguon. (i) Config: 5 ly do tu choi co ten, quy tac 0600, va ban tom tat che token. (j) Hai xfail(strict) ghim hai loi cua card khac: CR-TC-COLLECTOR-11 (duong alert khong the chay o bat ky wiring nao) va CR-TC-COLLECTOR-12 (payload claim khong validate voi chinh schema cua no, 7 vi pham).
